dialogue.Introduction: Oh, a farmer! Finally, somebody to talk to who isn't the Guide. I'm the Angler, and this is my fish shop. I'm not a kid, I'm a professional.$u#$b#Okay, I'm a kid. But I'm a professional kid.$h
dialogue.Mon: Monday already? Fish don't care what day it is, and neither do I.$h
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday tides are the best for catching things. Everybody else is at work, so the water is all mine.$h
dialogue.Wed: Hmph. Wednesday. The Merchant says I'm not allowed near the cash box. He's just jealous of my fishing.$a
dialogue.Thu: Thursday is for practicing my knots. Did you know there are a hundred knots? I know ninety-nine.$h
dialogue.Fri: Fridays are for gossip. The Party Girl says there's going to be a party, but she says that every day.$h
dialogue.Sat: Saturday! Let's go to the mines later. I hear there are fish down there that glow.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday. Quiet day. Good for sitting on the dock and thinking about big fish.$s
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, it's you. Did you bring my bucket back? Good. Don't touch the crate, there's a fish in it.$a
dialogue.Tue2: The Tavernkeep says I need to stop shouting at customers. I'm not shouting. I'm informing them.$u
dialogue.Wed2: Hm, your hat is kind of cool. Don't tell anyone I said that.$h
dialogue.Thu2: The Merchant tried to sell me a rod that's way too heavy. Please, I'm a fishing expert, not a fool.$a
dialogue.Fri2: Want a fish? I've got extras. You can pay me back by not touching the bucket, okay?$h
dialogue.Sat2: Saturday means the beach is full of tourists, and they all want to touch my fish. Gross.$a
dialogue.Sun2: Evening is the best time to fish. It's the only time nobody bugs me about my homework.$h
dialogue.Mon4: @! You're back already? I was just about to stop watching the water. Good timing.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Tuesdays are better now that you come by. Don't tell the gulls I said that.$l
dialogue.Wed4: Did you bring any bait? Real bait, not that stale worm stuff from the general store.$h
dialogue.Thu4: I'm going to show you the knot I invented. It's called the Willy Knot. I can't tell you how it works, it's a secret.$h
dialogue.Fri4: Friends are important. The Tavernkeep says so, and he's never been wrong. Mostly.$h
dialogue.Sat4: Want to race to the end of the pier? I'll give you a head start.$h
dialogue.Sun4: I've been thinking about my dad. He always told me patience wins the big fish. I think he's right, you know.$s
dialogue.Mon6: I'm learning to cast the long way now. My arm is sore, but my casts are better than the Guide's.$h
dialogue.Tue6: The Dryad says the sea and the forest are connected. I don't believe her, but the fish seem to agree.$u
dialogue.Wed6: Do you ever wonder what's out past the reef? I dream about going there someday, maybe on a big boat.$h
dialogue.Thu6: I practice my casts on the mine carts. They don't fight back, which is nice for a change.$h
dialogue.Fri6: The Pirate came by today asking for a fish. I gave him a seaweed sandwich. He said it was delicious, but he was lying.$h
dialogue.Sat6: I like being on the beach when the sun goes down. Everything turns orange and the fish get sleepy.$h
dialogue.Sun6: Sometimes I forget to eat lunch when I'm fishing. The Nurse says I need to eat. She says it like I'm a hundred years old.$a
dialogue.Mon8: Don't tell anyone, but I used to cry when I lost a fish. Now I just cry a little and then go catch another one.$s
dialogue.Tue8: @, you're the only one I'd show my secret fishing spot to. It's behind the rocks, and I'm not telling you exactly where.$h
dialogue.Wed8: Sometimes I think about the dreams I have. Scary eyes, big moons. The Guide says they're just dreams. I hope the Guide is right.$s
dialogue.Thu8: When you're here, the beach feels less lonely. Hm, I didn't say that. Forget I said it.$l
dialogue.Fri8: Remember the Angler's Quest? I finished it because of you. Every time I got stuck, you told me to keep trying.$h
dialogue.Sat8: Next summer I want to enter the fishing contest and win. Then you'll be my lucky charm, okay?$h
dialogue.Sun8: I'm glad you're my friend, @. I didn't have many before. Most kids think fishing is boring.$s
dialogue.Fri10: Everything I know about fishing I learned from making mistakes. Lots of them. Don't tell the Guide.$h
dialogue.Tue10: When I'm older I'll have a shop with a fish tank as big as the saloon. Maybe you'll come visit and bring a sandwich.$h
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat is awful. The fish all sink to the cool parts and I have to chase them. It's exhausting, honestly.$s
dialogue.winter_Fri8: I'm wearing three sweaters, @, and I still can't feel my toes. Winter fishing is a test of character.$u
dialogue.fall_15: Leaves are falling on the water and I keep catching them instead of fish. Hey, that's a joke. Ha.$h
dialogue.spring_Sat4: The beach is waking up again! Look, the little crabs are out. Careful, they bite, and I don't mean my jokes.$h

rainy: Rain means the big fish come up close to the shore. That's science. Also, my hat is soaked, and I'm not happy about it.$a

situations.eye: Did you hear? The giant eyeball in the sky got knocked out. Good riddance. I'm still not going on the night boats.$u
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds or the Brain of Cthulhu, whichever one it was, is gone from under the ground. The fish down there are very relieved.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is finally defeated and the dungeon is open! The Old Man got freed too, which is good, he has great stories. I'm not going in there alone, though.$u
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone! The honey shop has gone quiet. The bees are sulking, but I'm happy. Bees sting. Fish don't.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell and hardmode started! The Hallow is spreading everywhere and the fish glow weird colors. It's kind of cool, but I'm scared.$u
situations.mechs: One of those big mechanical bosses was destroyed! I heard the blast all the way down here. Mechanical things are so loud.$u
situations.plantera: Plantera is dead and the jungle temple is open! I want to see the flowers there, and maybe a huge fish in the jungle pond.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is defeated! The temple is quiet again. I still don't think stone idols should be napping so close to the water.$a
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is down, so the celestial pillars are showing up. I saw a glowing pillar from the beach. It made the seagulls scream.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is gone! The sky finally got quiet. I can sleep again, and so can the fish.$h
situations.goblins: We beat back a goblin army! I hid behind the net and yelled encouragement. Mostly I yelled, honestly.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates came, and the pirates left. Some of them tried to steal my bait. Nice try. Nobody steals from the Angler.$a
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion got sent back to the snow! Their snowballs were terrible, but they were very determined.$h
situations.martians: The Martians came and got beaten. Their ship lights were so bright. I want to know how they made those, but nobody will tell me.$u
situations.bloodMoon: Did you see the blood moon last night? The fish all hid and the water went dark red. It was creepy and I loved it.$u
situations.eclipse: The sun went out in the middle of the day! It was an eclipse. I watched the water turn dim. The fish were confused, like me.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today! She says I have to come, but I'm bringing my fishing rod and I'm not dancing.$h

festivals.spring13: The egg hunt! I'm not a baby, but I found the glowing egg under the dock first. Don't tell anyone I cheered for a whole second.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance! I'm only going if somebody asks me properly. Nobody has asked yet, so I'm fishing instead. Totally my choice.$s
festivals.summer11: The Luau! I put my best bass in the community soup this year. Everyone said it smelled amazing, and I didn't even burn it.$h
festivals.summer28: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies! The jellies glow on the beach at night. I'll stay up late and catch the brightest one, I promise.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! I'm entering the fishing games this year. I'll win fair and square, no matter what the Merchant says about it.$u
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The maze is spooky, but I'm not scared of ghosts. I'm only a little scared of the lighthouse. Okay, a lot.$s
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice! Ice fishing! I have been waiting all year for this. My toes will freeze, but the fish will be worth it.$h
festivals.winter25: Feast of the Winter Star! I got a gift from my secret friend, and I'm sure it's a fishing rod. Mostly sure. Please don't let it be socks.$h

loved.text: A catch! For me? This is the best fish I've ever seen. Okay, the second best. Thank you, @!$h

liked.text: Hmm, not bad. Not bad at all, @. I'll eat it while I fish.$h

neutral.text: Okay. I guess that's something, right?

disliked.text: Ew, what is this? Take it back, I'm not a trash collector.$a

hated.text: Gross! Get that away from my bucket right now!$a

events.after: Don't tell anyone about my secret stash of bait, okay?

steps.say: Hey! Don't just stand there, @. Look what I caught this morning!$h
A bass! A big one! Well, big for a fish my size, which is medium. But I caught it, so it's the best.#$b#Everybody says I'm too little to fish the deep water. I'm not too little. I'm just fast.$a

steps.question: Do you think I'm too young to be a real angler?

answers.text: No, you are a real angler.

answers.reply: Practice? I've been practicing since before I could walk!$a

steps.say: Here, you can have one of my trout. I have lots. Don't tell the Merchant I gave away stock.$h
Okay, that's enough showing off. Go catch something. A real fish, not a pebble from the pond.$u

events.after: If you see a huge golden fish out past the rocks, you come get me. Deal?

steps.say: @! You came to the beach. Nobody comes to the beach in the morning except me and the gulls.$h
I come down here every morning to check the tide. The sea is the only place in this town that doesn't tell me to go home and do my homework.$s
Don't laugh, okay? Last week I tried to catch the Golden Carp. It lives out past the rocks. I got my line tangled in a crab instead.$u

steps.question: Want to help me find the Golden Carp?

answers.reply: Really? Okay! You can hold the bucket. That's a very important job.$h
Hmph. Fine. I'll fish alone, see if I care.$s

steps.say: Grown-ups keep telling me to be patient. I AM patient. I've been patient for three whole years!$a
...Thanks for listening, @. Don't tell the others I was sad, okay?$s

events.after: The Guide says the best catches come after dark. I'm going to test that theory every night.

steps.say: Oh! @, perfect timing. The Guide was just telling me about the old fishing tales.$h
Hm, a young angler, eh? Fishing at night is a fine way to learn patience. The lakes hold their secrets for those who wait.$h
I'm not learning patience. I'm waiting for the big ones to come up. It's the same thing, mostly.$h

steps.question: Do you believe in lucky fishing spots?

answers.reply: Good. Luck is half of fishing. The other half is never giving up.$h
Sure, sure, grown-up talk. Keep your opinion. I'll keep my fish.$a

steps.say: Keep your line tight and your heart steady. The fish can smell fear, you know.$h
Hey! That was a bite! Oh no, it got away. Typical.$a
Thanks, Guide! I'm going to catch a Golden Carp before the end of summer, you'll see.$h
I will believe it when I see it, young one.$h
@, you can stay and watch the moon with me, if you want.$h

events.after: Thanks for coming over. I feel a lot better now, so don't worry about me.

steps.say: @, you're up late. Come in, the door's open. Mind the bucket.$s
I had a bad dream. There were huge eyes in the sky, and they were looking down at the valley.$s

steps.question: Do you think the bad things in the world can reach Pelican Town?

answers.text: Not while I am here to keep watch.
answers.reply: You would really do that? Okay. Then I'll keep watch too, and we can take turns.$h
Then don't say that. I'm trying to sleep.$s

steps.say: Thanks for staying, @. Sleeping is easier when someone's around. Don't tell anyone I said that.$h
Hey... Can you tell me a story about the fishing contest? The one where somebody's bobber sank?$h

events.after: I'm going to frame my Angler's Quest board. Right next to my fish.

steps.say: @! Guess what? I finished the whole Angler's Quest board! Every single one of them! Look at my bucket of tokens!$h
The Guide helped with the hard ones. Mostly I just didn't quit. Now say it, @. Say I'm the best kid angler in the valley!$h

steps.question: You are the best kid angler in the valley.

answers.text: You are the best kid angler in the valley.
answers.reply: Hehe! I knew you'd say it. Finally, somebody who gets it.$h

answers.text: Maybe. There are a lot of kids out there.
answers.reply: Hmph! Then I'll just have to prove it again with bigger fish.$a

steps.say: Ahem. I will admit the boy has grit. Grit, mind you, not manners.$h
Hey! I have manners! Mostly.$h
Here, take this. The Fisherman's Guide. I already know everything in it, so it's yours now.$h
